# United Knots

> > United Knots is a UK-based macrame supplies store offering premium single ply cotton cords, metal frames, and craft accessories for plant hangers and decorative projects.

Founded by macrame artist Robyn Gough in Bournemouth, United Knots specializes in UK-made and GRS-certified recycled macrame cords in various colors and thicknesses (3mm, 3.5mm, 4mm). The store provides professional-grade materials for DIY crafters and macrame enthusiasts.

## Key Topics

- Single ply macrame cord
- 3mm and 3.5mm cotton rope
- UK-made craft supplies
- Plant hanger materials
- Robyn Gough (founder)
- GRS-certified recycled cord
- Copper metal frames and rings
- DIY macrame projects
- Single ply cotton
- Bournemouth-based business
- Macrame weaving supplies
- Colored macrame cords
- GDPR compliance
